contract_header:
use spec = "dgq3l4gvriw55as3gylubcaxotdgyg2wfanwfra72ri3doo5ayva"  // ct_lt_spec.ode

fn ct_bytes_lt(a: n bytes, b: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n < 1000000000
    returns spec.bytes_lt(a, b)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement and verify `ct_bytes_lt`: big-endian lexicographic comparison `a < b` returning 1 if `a < b` and 0 otherwise, with an execution trace depending on the length `n` alone (never on the bytes of `a` or `b`).
title: Big-endian lexicographic `<` whose trace depends on the length alone
